source: segmentation (Blender simulation, background replaced by plain white)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, units px

camera.motion: static (background is uniform white RGB 255 in every frame; no pan/shake possible to measure and none implied)
camera.perspective: 2D scene; no ground plane, horizon or vanishing points visible. Use one metres-per-pixel scale for both objects.

objects.name: ball
objects.description: small red sphere (dark red, slightly shaded), the only red object; starts upper-centre at about (962, 253)
objects.reference_point: intensity-weighted centre of the ball (= sphere centre/origin), columns cx_px, cy_px
objects.motion: falls straight down (x constant 961.9 +- 0.15 px) from rest; y 253.45 at frame 0 -> 977.62 at frame 37 (net 724.2 px down); still falling at last frame, no bounce/impact

objects.name: forklift
objects.description: orange-and-black Toyota counterbalance forklift seen side-on, forks/mast at right (front faces +x), lower-left of frame
objects.track: tracks/forklift.csv (ref_x_px/ref_y_px = frame-0 bbox centre + sub-pixel template shift; bbox and mask columns per frame); tracks/forklift_shift.csv (raw template shift)
objects.reference_point: bbox centre of the full silhouette, (271.0, 935.5) at frame 0, carried rigidly by template shift (ref_x_px, ref_y_px)

size_px.note: length includes rear counterweight to front of mast/fork carriage (forks themselves are lowered and hidden behind the front wheel)

objects.motion: drives right (+x) along y = const (y drift < 0.25 px); net +120.1 px over frames 0-37

events.event: ball release / start of fall from rest
events.evidence: parabola fit of cy(t) over frames 2-37 has vertex at frame -0.01 (y 253.16), rms residual 0.13 px
dx frame0->1 = 0.04 px, then increasing steadily

events.event: forklift per-frame dx levels off at ~3.0-3.5 px/frame
end of clip, ball still airborne (centre y 977.6, bottom 989, ground line 1056)

contacts: none: ball (x~962) and forklift (x <= 537) never overlap; ball never reaches ground in clip
